title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: The statement that no price is published is too broad: Microsoft publishes a Copilot Studio pay-as-you-go price of $0.01 per credit, although credits consumed per journey remain undocumented. The roadmap facts, preview qualifications and principal enablement controls are supported; several control descriptions need minor clarification.

claims.fix: Set controls[2].api.call to "PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01". In the row note state: "The body identifies scope.environmentId and sets allocatedEntitlements[].allocation.quantity for entitlementId MCSMessages; enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled false disables tenant-pool draw." Remove the request body from the rendered call as well.
